film-iron-man: Billionaire weapons maker Tony Stark is captured, builds a suit to escape and becomes Iron Man. The film that started it all.
film-the-incredible-hulk: Bruce Banner is on the run from the army while trying to cure himself. Edward Norton plays Banner here; Mark Ruffalo takes over later.
film-iron-man-2: Tony is dying from his own arc reactor while a Russian rival builds copycat suits. Introduces Black Widow and War Machine.
film-thor: Arrogant Thor is banished to Earth without his hammer and has to earn it back, while Loki plots in Asgard.
film-captain-america-the-first-avenger: A scrawny kid from Brooklyn becomes a super-soldier in World War II and fights HYDRA. Meet Steve, Peggy and Bucky.
film-the-avengers: Nick Fury brings the heroes together for the first time to stop Loki's alien invasion of New York.
film-iron-man-3: After New York, Tony struggles with anxiety and takes on a terrorist called the Mandarin.
film-thor-the-dark-world: Thor fights the Dark Elves over the Aether, which turns out to be the Reality Stone.
film-captain-america-the-winter-soldier: Steve discovers HYDRA has been hiding inside S.H.I.E.L.D. all along, and comes face to face with Bucky. Introduces Sam Wilson.
film-guardians-of-the-galaxy: A team of space misfits, led by Star-Lord, fight over the Power Stone. Thanos is in it too.
film-avengers-age-of-ultron: Tony builds an AI to protect Earth and creates Ultron. Introduces Wanda and Vision.
film-ant-man: Ex-con Scott Lang steals a suit that shrinks him, and gets his first trip to the Quantum Realm.
film-captain-america-civil-war: The Avengers split over government control, Team Cap vs. Team Iron Man. Debuts Spider-Man and Black Panther.
film-doctor-strange: A surgeon loses the use of his hands and finds the Mystic Arts. Introduces the Time Stone and the multiverse.
film-guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2: Star-Lord meets his father, a living planet, and the Guardians become a real family.
film-spider-man-homecoming: Peter Parker tries to balance high school and life as Spider-Man, with Tony as his mentor.
film-thor-ragnarok: Thor loses his hammer to Hela, ends up fighting the Hulk on a junk planet, and Asgard falls.
film-black-panther: T'Challa becomes king of Wakanda and faces a challenger with a claim to the throne.
film-avengers-infinity-war: Thanos comes for all six Infinity Stones, and the heroes can't stop him. Ends with the Snap.
film-ant-man-and-the-wasp: Scott and Hope try to rescue Janet from the Quantum Realm. Its mid-credits scene ties into Infinity War.
film-captain-marvel: A 1990s story about Carol Danvers discovering her past and her cosmic powers. Young Nick Fury co-stars.
film-avengers-endgame: Five years after the Snap, the Avengers travel through time to undo it. The end of the Infinity Saga.
film-spider-man-far-from-home: Peter goes on a school trip to Europe and meets Mysterio. Shows the world after the Blip.
film-black-widow: Natasha reunites with her sister Yelena and her fake Russian family. Yelena now leads the New Avengers.
film-shang-chi-and-the-legend-of-the-ten: Shang-Chi faces his father, the man behind the Ten Rings, and a dark magical threat.
film-eternals: Ancient immortal beings who have secretly guarded Earth for thousands of years reunite to stop a cosmic event.
film-spider-man-no-way-home: A spell to make the world forget Peter goes wrong and pulls in villains and Spider-Men from other universes.
film-doctor-strange-in-the-multiverse-of: Strange races across the multiverse to protect America Chavez from the Scarlet Witch. Introduces incursions.
film-thor-love-and-thunder: Thor teams up with Jane Foster, now the Mighty Thor, to stop Gorr the God Butcher.
film-black-panther-wakanda-forever: Wakanda mourns T'Challa and faces Namor's underwater kingdom. Shuri becomes the new Black Panther.
film-ant-man-and-the-wasp-quantumania: The Lang family gets pulled into the Quantum Realm and meets Kang the Conqueror.
film-guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3: The Guardians fight to save Rocket and face the High Evolutionary. The original team's farewell.
film-the-marvels: Carol, Monica and Kamala swap places whenever they use their powers. The mid-credits scene introduces Beast.
film-deadpool-wolverine: Deadpool recruits a broken Wolverine to save his dying universe from the TVA.
film-captain-america-brave-new-world: Sam's first film as Captain America, caught in a global plot involving President Ross.
film-thunderbolts: Yelena, Bucky and other misfits are set up to be erased and end up as the New Avengers.
film-the-fantastic-four-first-steps: Marvel's First Family protects their retro Earth-828 from Galactus. Doom appears in the mid-credits scene.
film-spider-man-brand-new-day: Peter's first story since the world forgot him. Set before Doomsday.
film-avengers-doomsday: Heroes from three universes face Doctor Doom. In theaters December 18, 2026.
film-avengers-secret-wars: The finale of the Multiverse Saga, arriving December 17, 2027.
